---
title: "check-title-references.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that flags a reference to a section, chapter, or page by its title that does not name the content type.
It fails by default, since agents ignore warnings (Ezra, 2026-11-02).
The rule (Ezra, 2026-11-16, psw#660): when text refers to a section, subsection, chapter, page and so on by its title,
it names the type of content, and only the title is the link text.
Write `the [Practical considerations](#practical-considerations) section`,
not `see [Practical considerations](#practical-considerations)`.

The check flags a Markdown link on a line the pull request adds when both hold:

- **Title as link text.**
  The target is internal: `#anchor`, `page.qmd#anchor`, `page.html#anchor`, or `page.qmd`.
  The link text equals the title of the heading the anchor names, with case and markup ignored.
  For a bare page link, it equals the `title:` of the page.
- **No content type beside it.**
  No type word sits immediately before the link or immediately after it.
  The type words are section, subsection, chapter, page, part, appendix, lecture, handout, unit, and module.
  The type word may be followed by "titled", "called", or "named", then by an opening quote.

The check does not count:

- a `@sec-` crossref, which renders its own "Section n" label;
- a link to a `#def-` or `#thm-` div, which targets no heading;
- a link inside a code fence, a code span, an HTML comment, or the YAML front matter;
- a line carrying, or following, `<!-- check-title-references: allow -->`.

The check cannot see a book, article, or video, whose title lives off-site.
The reviewer instruction in psw covers books, articles, and videos.

## Scope

A finding is reported only when the line was added in the pull request,
so existing references are not swept.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked page in full on purpose.
The heading index always reads every tracked `.qmd` file.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default    | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd *.md'`  | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`       | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`     | Fail the workflow when an added link names a title without its content type. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`    | Scan every tracked page in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`   | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-title-references.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a link whose text is the title of the heading or page it
# targets, with no content type (section, chapter, page, ...) beside it (psw#660).
# Fails by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check title references

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-title-references.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                         # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: false                            # warn instead of block (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every page, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-title-references.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-title-references.yml)
for the full caller stub.
